title: The Empaneled Hour (Part 2)
description: The studio has been empaneled and it's rising. Ronnie, calm as ever, gavels his own show to order, only to learn he's the foreperson of a verdict in which he is also the defendant. Barry phones in from the parking lot to have Ronnie dismissed, the bailiff keeps thanking everyone for their service, and the only way down is a verdict nobody's allowed to deliver until the broadcast convicts itself.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: We're back on Snazzie FM, and the studio is, well, up. <p:0.3> Mics are rising, the chairs are rising, and Orrin here tells me I'm running the show. <p:0.3> Court is in session.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Correct, foreperson. <p:0.3> You may bang the gavel. <p:0.2> There is no gavel. <p:0.2> The court thanks you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now that's the kind of service you don't get on other stations. <p:0.3> Alright, Orrin, let's read the charges so we can wrap by the top of the hour.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The charge is broadcasting without a verdict, sir. <p:0.3> The defendant is you. <p:0.2> The foreperson is also you.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie! Ronnie, it's me, I'm calling in from the PARKING LOT. I got out. I got OUT of the building.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Barry. Good of you to phone the program. We've got a lovely segment going.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: It's not a SEGMENT, you're on trial! <p:0.3> Orrin, I want him dismissed. I'm requesting that the foreperson be excused.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Request noted, caller. <p:0.3> The foreperson may not excuse the foreperson. <p:0.2> Only the jury may.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, there we are. Where's the jury, Orrin?

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The listeners, sir. <p:0.3> Every receiver tuned in was empaneled at the top of the hour. <p:0.2> All rise.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: The LISTENERS? You empaneled the audience? There are people RISING in their KITCHENS right now, Ronnie!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Can confirm. <p:0.3> I was making toast, friend. <p:0.3> Now I'm near the ceiling fan and we're still deliberating.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Chen, good to have you back on the jury.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Never left, Ronnie. <p:0.3> You can't leave before the verdict. <p:0.2> I told the toast. The toast knows.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Ronnie, it's Kim! I'm out! I'm at a BUS STOP! And I'm STILL going up!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Kim, you were excused! He said permanently!

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Yeah, well, permanently apparently means I'm a JUROR again! I never even got a SECOND letter!

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: You were re-empaneled, ma'am. <p:0.3> Convicts serve too. <p:0.2> The court thanks you for your continued service.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Alright, jury, let's do this clean. <p:0.3> As foreperson, I'll just poll the room. <p:0.3> All in favor of letting the defendant, me, go home.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Aye.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: Aye! Big aye!

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Aye! From the parking lot, AYE!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Motion carries. <p:0.3> Orrin, the jury has spoken. Read the verdict and let's all come down.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: The verdict cannot be delivered until the foreperson signs it, sir. <p:0.3> You have no pen. <p:0.2> The pen is evidence.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Then GIVE him the evidence!

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Evidence may not leave the room.

lines.speaker: caller-kim
lines.text: And the room is RISING!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: The toast is rising too, friend.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Nobody cares about the TOAST, Chen!

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Tell you what, Orrin. As foreperson, I move to sign with a pen that's also evidence. <p:0.3> I'll allow it. I'm the judge of that.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: Sustained, Your Honor. <p:0.3> The verdict is signed. <p:0.2> Guilty. <p:0.2> The studio is excused. Permanently.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: We're coming DOWN, right? Ronnie, tell me we're coming down.

lines.speaker: bailiff-orrin
lines.text: All rise. <p:0.3> There is an appeal. <p:0.2> The whole city has been empaneled now.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Well, folks, sounds like the entire listening area is going up with us. <p:0.3> So if you can hear me, grab something. <p:0.3> And thank you. <p:0.3> For your service.
